observations: A used internal combustion engine with a black plastic valve cover.
A black timing belt cover is visible on the right side.
The engine is mounted on a black rubber base.
A barcode sticker is visible on the side of the engine block.
The engine is surrounded by other mechanical parts and hoses.
The photo appears to be taken in a workshop or scrap yard environment.

risks.risk: The engine may be seized or have internal mechanical damage.
risks.proof: A video of the engine being cranked over by a hand-crank or a video of it running.

risks.risk: The engine may not be the correct fitment for the buyer's vehicle.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine code or the vehicle identification number (VIN) stamped on the engine block.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic used engine without a specific fitment

risks.risk: The timing belt may be old and brittle, or the timing may be off.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the timing belt cover and a video showing the timing marks.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a timing belt replacement

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine code or VIN stamped on the metal block.
Video of the engine being cranked over to check for smooth operation.
Photo of the timing belt cover and the engine's timing marks.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
